description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
